source_evidence: click on the Variable Insurance Products Search under the same menu; For the best results, search by the marketing name of the variable annuity contract; The prospectus includes information about a variable annuity such as its fees, investment options, and insurance features
answer: To research a variable annuity in EDGAR, open Variable Insurance Products Search and search by the contract’s marketing name. Check both the contract name and the insurance company name in the results, since names can be similar. Form N-4/485 is a registration statement that includes a prospectus describing the contract’s fees, investment options, and insurance features. Form 497 provides periodic updates to the variable annuity prospectus.
